description: Name: Rechovot Beit Haim WeizmanDescription: Beit Chaim Weizman (also known as the Weizman Villa or the Weizman Mansion and sometimes even the "President's Palace") was the private home of the first president of the State of Israel, Dr. Chaim Weizman, and his wife, Dr. Vera Weizman. The house is located on a hill in Rehovot, which is now part of the Weizmann Institute of Science campus.
